jira-email-hint: Corporate Jira login or email used for assignee mapping on sync.
leave-empty-to-create-dummy-user: leave empty to create dummy user
dummy-user-dont-have-email-but-can-work-: dummy user don't have email but can work in projects
label: Label
closed-text: flag for closed task used for search
log-time-text: when this status is set show log time dialog
completed-text: task will not be scheduled and count as completed
rebot-text: all task with this status will be scheduled
title: Title
jira-token-in-profile-hint: Set your personal Jira token under
jira-rest-url-hint: Base with /rest, e.g. https://jira.example.com/rest (no trailing slash).
jira-hook-hint: Optional. Marked as unavailable when webhooks cannot be reached from Jira.
jira-jql-hint: Jira → Renwu. Example: project = VKVIDEO AND assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved
jira-oql-hint: Renwu → Jira. Mongo filter without outer {}: "container.key":"MSC"
jira-import-auto-hint: Periodic Import by the Connection JQL. Uses your Profile → Jira PAT. Separate from Push mode (Renwu → Jira).
jira-export-oql-create-started: Export started: {{total}} issues (create missing in Jira)
jira-push-mode-hint: Controls whether task changes are exported to Jira automatically.
jira-push-manual: Manual — only buttons and bulk sync
jira-push-auto-mapped: Auto for mapped tasks — skip create without mapping
jira-epic-link-field-hint: Jira custom field id, e.g. customfield_15500. Empty disables Epic Link on export.
jira-epic-types-hint: Which Renwu types count as Epic when resolving parent Epic Link. Stored in Mongo (epic_our_type_ids). Empty falls back to label/type_mapping name Epic.
jira-story-points-field-hint: Deprecated: configure under Templates (Story Points button). 1 SP = 8h.
jira-mappings-hint: Top: Epic types (epic_our_type_ids in Mongo). Below: each Renwu value is a row; pick Jira via search. Story Points and Epic Link live under Templates.
jira-templates-hint: First template whose When conditions all match (AND) wins. Empty When is the Default fallback. Presets add fields to the selected template (for MSC — both MSC templates): Jira Key (1:1, old key kept in keys[]), Epic Link, Story Points (1 SP = 8h).
jira-when-hint: Empty conditions = default template. For “in”, list values separated by commas.
jira-bulk-drift-hint: Diff is the union of OQL + JQL + all mapped issues. Then pull, push, or create in Jira.
jira-no-diff: No diff loaded yet. Click Show diff.
jira-diff-empty: Nothing to diff: JQL/OQL matched nothing and there are no mapped issues.
ai-run-via-runner-hint: When on, the cloud service stops claiming this tenant's AI job queue — only a registered local runner (see the Runners tab) picks up and executes jobs. When off (default), the cloud service executes jobs itself, as before.
ai-bot-hint: Create a dummy user, add them to the project, and select them here. A job starts only when this bot is an assignee and the status matches a workflow step.
ai-prompt-template-hint: Placeholders: {{skill_body}}, {{issue_id}}, {{issue_key}}, {{issue_title}}, {{issue_status}}, {{issue_description}}, {{issue_comments}}, {{workdir}}. Final answer must be RENWU_RESULT JSON (outcome/description/questions).
ai-apply-session-done: Latest session answer applied to the issue
ai-step-delivery-hint: Creates a git worktree, scopes the agent to it, and parses delivery/MR results. Configure prompt_template (and resolve_repository_template) on this step.
ai-step-resolve-repo-hint: Delivery only. Placeholders: {{issue_key}}, {{issue_title}}, {{issue_description}}, {{workdir}}. End with RENWU_REPOSITORY: <path>.
ai-step-followup-hint: Optional. Used when continuing the agent session. Same placeholders as first-turn. Empty → reuse first-turn prompt.
ai-runners-hint: A runner is a background process on your machine that pulls AI jobs from the queue and runs claude/opencode locally. Register one, copy its token, and start it — see docs/adr/101_ai_runner.md for the runner binary.
ai-runner-token-created: Runner registered — copy the token now, it will not be shown again
ai-runner-revoke-text: The runner stops being able to pull jobs immediately. This can't be undone — a new token means registering a new runner.
ai-workspace-required: Name, container and workdir are required
ai-workspace-provider-hint: Optional: override the AI provider for this workspace/project. Leave empty to inherit from AI settings.
ai-cleanup-worktree-text: The local checkout will be removed. The remote branch and merge request will remain.
ai-config-io-hint: Download or upload settings, workspaces, skills, and workflows as JSON. Jobs are not included. Tokens stay personal.
ai-import-text: Settings, workspaces, skills, and workflows from the file will overwrite matching IDs. Jobs are unchanged.
jira-config-io-hint: Download or upload org Jira URL, filters, mappings, and templates as JSON. Personal tokens and issue links are not included.
jira-import-text: Organization Jira settings from the file will replace the current ones. Personal tokens and issue mappings stay as they are.
ai-gates-mode-hint: Shadow never blocks on gates. Enforce blocks by default on run_gates_after; set require_gates_pass=false on a step to opt out.
ai-allowed-tools-hint: Allowlist of tools/commands (read_only = allowlist, not deny-write). Enforced on Claude Code; OpenCode gets a prompt prefix.
ai-result-schema-hint: Optional. For grooming include affected_projects[]. Empty = no schema validation yet beyond harvest.
